Added (high-confidence? edi-change) to the conjunction so low-confidence swings no longer arbitrate, keeping pct/exposure/frozen gates unchanged; recall headroom (1.0 vs 0.8 gate) absorbs any lost low-confidence true positives.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
